# Manual evidence derivation only; no repository adoption/default mutation.
require_relative '../../scripts/maintenance/lib/bundled_attribution'
require_relative '../../scripts/maintenance/lib/plugin_attribution'
include Maintenance
root = File.expand_path('../..', __dir__)
base = __dir__
store = RunStore.new(File.join(root, '.maintenance/runs-adoption-direct-inputs'))
build_id = 'a0e38241252627d396a90e99f0c57368'
plugin_id = ARGV.fetch(0)
build = CompatibilityReport.read(store, build_id)
plugins = store.lock(plugin_id, create: false) { PluginAttribution.report(store, plugin_id) }
raise Failure, 'Plugin source differs from fresh build' unless plugins['original_binding'] == build['binding']
reference = BundledAttribution.report(root, RunStore.new(File.join(root, '.maintenance/runs-upstream-remediation')), 'ee4c6a7e32a1db3782ec81933a02522d')
expected = reference.fetch('bundled_settings_inputs').values_at('matches', 'unassigned').flatten.map { |a| a.slice('name', 'identity') }.sort_by { |a| a['name'] }
raise Failure, 'Incomplete reference attribution' unless expected.size == 215 && expected.map { |a| a['name'] }.uniq.size == 215 && reference.dig('bundled_file_attribution', 'state') == 'measured_file_identities_accounted_for'
phases = %w[baseline candidate].to_h do |phase|
  control = File.join(store.path(build_id), 'steps', phase + '-direct-build-inputs')
  packets = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(control, 'delegated-graphs.json')))
  measured = packets.flat_map { |packet| BuildInputs.delegated!(packet.fetch('data')) }.select { |row| row['owner'] == 'settings' }.flat_map { |row| Array(row['artifacts']) }.select { |a| a.dig('component', 'kind') == 'opaque' }.map { |a| a.slice('name', 'identity') }.uniq.sort_by { |a| a['name'] }
  raise Failure, 'Fresh bundled settings artifact drift' unless measured == expected
  [phase, { 'measured_files' => measured, 'delegated_packets_sha256' => Maintenance.digest(packets) }]
end
projection = {
  'schema' => 1, 'kind' => 'manual_exact_fresh_file_identity_join',
  'fresh_build' => build.slice('run_id', 'result_sha256', 'binding'),
  'fresh_plugins' => plugins.slice('run_id', 'result_sha256', 'original_binding'),
  'verified_reference' => reference.slice('run_id', 'result_sha256', 'binding'),
  'verified_reference_attribution_sha256' => reference.dig('bundled_file_attribution', 'receipt_sha256'),
  'phases' => phases, 'bundled_file_count' => 215,
  'reference_maven_files' => reference.dig('bundled_settings_inputs', 'matches').size,
  'independent_maven_files' => reference.dig('bundled_file_attribution', 'independent_maven_count'),
  'registered_source_module_files' => reference.dig('bundled_file_attribution', 'source_module_count'),
  'candidate_maven_resolution' => 'not_inferred', 'source_binary_reproducibility' => 'unproven',
  'deriver_sha256' => Maintenance.file_sha(__FILE__), 'adoption_authorized' => false
}
report = Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(build))
report['bundled_file_attribution'] = { 'state' => 'fresh_bytes_joined_to_verified_reference_producers', 'receipt_sha256' => Maintenance.digest(projection) }
report['direct_resolution'].each do |_phase, data|
  queries = data.fetch('advisory_queries').fetch('queries') + reference.dig('bundled_settings_inputs', 'advisory_queries') + reference.dig('bundled_file_attribution', 'queries') + plugins.dig('plugin_attribution', 'candidate', 'queries')
  data['advisory_queries']['queries'] = queries.uniq.sort_by { |q| [q['package']['name'], q['version']] }
end
projection['phase_query_sets_identical'] = report.dig('direct_resolution', 'baseline', 'advisory_queries', 'queries') == report.dig('direct_resolution', 'candidate', 'advisory_queries', 'queries')
report['input_evidence_sha256'] = Maintenance.digest(projection)
report['bundled_file_attribution']['receipt_sha256'] = Maintenance.digest(projection)
RunStore.atomic(File.join(base, 'direct-advisory-projection.json'), projection)
RunStore.atomic(File.join(base, 'direct-advisory-report-input.json'), report)
['candidate'].each do |phase|
  path = File.join(base, 'direct-advisories-' + phase + '.json')
  receipt = AdvisoryReview.collect(report, phase: phase, checkpoint: ->(packet) { RunStore.atomic(path, packet) })
  summary = AdvisoryReview.verify!(receipt, report)
  RunStore.atomic(File.join(base, 'direct-advisories-' + phase + '-summary.json'), summary)
  puts JSON.generate('phase' => phase, 'state' => summary['state'], 'query_count' => summary['query_count'], 'finding_count' => summary['finding_ids'].size, 'reasons' => summary['reasons'])
end
